verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents design tokens, variables, color or text styles, or a mode/theme system in Framer. The closest items are AI-agent prompt examples (site-wide brand color changes, typography updates, switching to dark mode), which describe one-off agent edits rather than managed variables with modes applied across designs. These are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs
